purpose: Make the A0 nomination decision reproducible before either scale-normalized candidate is executed.
baseline: Frozen F-LMFP09 n49 absolute-head endpoint-pair provider evaluated on the same revealed C7a probe rows.

R4_non_owner_tail.metric: median over classes of candidate active-max-relative-error divided by n49 active-max-relative-error

R3_geometry_strong_gradient.metric: maximum over the two classes of candidate strong-gradient-p90 divided by n49 strong-gradient-p90

passing_controls.metric: median over classes of candidate active-p90 divided by n49 active-p90

owner_overlap_diagnostic_only.reason: These classes overlap the known legacy near-saturation K discontinuity seam and therefore cannot by themselves select or reject the numerical coordinate family. Their metrics remain visible.

row_level_improvement_requirement.population: all active rows in the ten R4_non_owner_tail classes on which both candidate and n49 return finite values
row_level_improvement_requirement.metric: fraction with candidate relative error strictly smaller than n49 relative error

coherent_candidate: A candidate is coherent only if every global structural requirement holds, tail_score<1, geometry_score<1, control_score<=1.25, and failed-tail row-level better fraction>0.5.

nomination_rule.one_coherent: Nominate that candidate for a separately precommitted A1 geometry-axis characterization.
nomination_rule.none_coherent: A0_NO_COHERENT_SCALE_NORMALIZED_CANDIDATE. Do not tune nodes or thresholds on A0 data.
nomination_rule.both_coherent_and_one_pareto_dominates: Nominate the candidate whose tail_score and geometry_score are both <= the other candidate and at least one is strictly lower, provided its control_score is also <= the other candidate.
nomination_rule.both_coherent_tradeoff: Do not choose by an invented weighted score. Persist A0 as AMBIGUOUS_TRADEOFF and precommit a separate discriminator before further evaluation.

not_used_for_nomination: material-specific exception lists beyond the predeclared diagnostic groups
